incumbent.rule: cross-sectional discount LEVEL decile tilt, ETB-short-screened, price>$5, 4-week hold, weekly overlapping tranches, dollar-neutral

data.source: 100% cached: t12_cache (CEFConnect 5Y weekly + Alpaca adjusted daily bars)
data.no_bdcs: CEFConnect DailyPricing carries 0 BDCs (26 Morningstar CEF categories, all closed-end funds). BDC NAV is quarterly and no free wired source exists in this repo, so the BDC branch of the brief is NOT testable here.

window.holdout_is_not_virgin_at_family_level: The incumbent L5 was already measured in this block at ann Sharpe 2.35. A new formula that merely correlates with it will inherit that number. The decisive held-out statistic is therefore the ALPHA to the incumbent, not the raw Sharpe -- both are reported.

costs.note: both legs charged the measured CEF half-spread on realised turnover; borrow charged at the REALISED 200 bp short rate on the short half, not the 33 bp ETB floor; short leg screened to Alpaca easy_to_borrow

noise_bar.basis: sqrt(2 ln 2N), two-sided over N scored formulas
